source.title: Hydrogen station in situ back-to-back fueling data for design and modeling
source.reuse_license: not established for the operator logs

observed_evidence.facility: Cal State LA Hydrogen Research and Fueling Facility, California, USA
observed_evidence.reported_campaign: one year of fueling-event and station-response measurements
reported_scenarios: back-to-back fueling defined as less than five minutes between fills

eligibility_decision.reason: The public article record provides field operating context and aggregate/performance analyses, but no downloadable synchronized station, dispenser and vehicle logger archive with channel definitions, calibration uncertainty or reuse permission.
allowed_use: data-request lead for de-identified event-level exports
face-validity comparison for back-to-back fueling behavior
prohibited_use: parameter tuning of the locked model
claim of raw-log or vehicle-level validation

next_action: Request de-identified event-level pressure, temperature, mass-flow, storage state, compressor/controller state, vehicle/receptacle state and calibration metadata from the HRFF custodians; freeze model and scoring before numerical outcomes are accessed.
claim_boundary: This record strengthens real-station source accounting only. It is not raw validation evidence and does not change the IJHE or full-objective completion gates.
